title: TDSB address finder — curated summary
text: TDSB offers a street-number and street-name lookup for schools serving a residential address for regular programs. App implementation note: this prototype queries the official finder on explicit address-form submission and displays returned schools and board notes. The finder has no school-year selector; the requested school year and individual admission eligibility are not verified by this lookup. Distance, postal code or manually selecting a pilot profile does not establish school assignment. Address queries are not sent to the language model.

title: Ontario elementary curriculum — curated provincial guidance
text: Ontario curriculum sets expectations for what students learn. Elementary subjects include language, mathematics, science and technology, and social studies. Consult the provincial guidance for grade-specific expectations.

title: TDSB Kindergarten learning — curated board guidance
text: TDSB describes Kindergarten as inquiry and intentional play-based learning, planned by teachers and early childhood educators.

title: TDSB registration dates — curated board guidance
text: English Kindergarten registration begins in January. The board directs families to their local school for exact dates and times; no school-specific deadline is verified here. For September 2027 entry, Early French Immersion JK applications open November 2, 2026 and close November 27, 2026. This is a separate central application, not an English Kindergarten deadline or a guaranteed placement at Joyce or Glen Park. School-specific deadlines and other-year French application dates are not verified in this corpus.

title: EQAO school results lookup — curated guidance
text: EQAO reports assessment results; these are different from an overall school rating. Use the school name and address to find the correct school and review the assessment year and grade. Numeric results for the pilot schools have not been verified in this corpus.

title: Fraser school ratings — curated publisher guidance
text: Fraser publishes third-party academic ratings, separate from official EQAO results. Reviewed numeric scores are stored by verified TDSB school identifier in the app rating directory. School rating questions use that directory with assessment year and report edition. An unverified school remains unknown; a rating is not an overall judgment of school quality.
